reader_summary.overview: Ben and David head north of the border to Ottawa, Canada to cover perhaps one of the greatest IPO success stories of the past 5 years. From humble beginnings as a “lifestyle business” hawking hipster snowboard gear online to now routinely mentioned in the same breath as Amazon. Editor's note: Shopify actually powered $41b of sales, not $14b, in 2018, as discussed toward the end of the episode.
